item.title: Congo Ebola outbreak death toll surpasses 4,000 after treatment center burned
item.description: Congo’s Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people since it was declared in eastern Congo on May 15, the Health Ministry announced Thursday, as the country continues to grapple with the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history. The latest figures show 4,018 deaths among 8,300 recorded cases.…

item.title: Brazil votes Sunday in high-stakes presidential rematch between Lula and Bolsonaro's son
item.description: Brazilians vote Sunday in a presidential election that pits 80-year-old leftist incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva against far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, 45, the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro — a rematch of the bitter 2022 contest with outsized stakes for Brazil and for Latin…

item.title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, killing at least five across Ukraine and Russia
item.description: A Russian strike hit a second major bridge in Kyiv on Saturday, Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko said, as Moscow intensified attacks on critical infrastructure in Ukraine's capital. The attack on the Pivnichnyi (Northern) Bridge injured two people and damaged the road surface and overhead trolleybus wires…

item.title: Trump names Jay Clayton AI czar after 'super intelligence' order
item.description: The White House this week signed a new executive order rebranding artificial intelligence as "super intelligence" and secured a "morally binding" safety pledge from major tech CEOs.

item.title: Measles outbreaks spread in multiple states; Pennsylvania reports fifth death, New York and Ohio see new cases
